reading.body:
Altered is a UK-based voice AI company focused on professional audio production tools, with no recorded litigation, patents, or major capital raises tracked in available data.

The company positions itself in the narrower segment of voice AI: tools for creators and media producers rather than conversational AI or voice assistants. Its product suite spans Speech-To-Speech morphing, voice editing applied to existing media, real-time voice changing, and dubbing, all hosted on UK infrastructure. This focus on media workflows and consent management suggests Altered is targeting licensed use cases where provenance and creator control matter, rather than the high-volume inference workloads that drive compute demand for large language models or image generation.

The data reveals nothing about Altered's scale, training infrastructure, or power consumption. A company offering voice editing and morphing tools consumes far less compute than one training foundation models, but the absence of funding records, patents, or litigation does not indicate the company is small, stalled, or dormant. It may simply operate below the threshold of public capitalization events or regulatory filings tracked here. The UK hosting choice is noted but the data does not explain whether this reflects regulatory preference, customer demand, or infrastructure economics specific to voice workloads.

profile_text.body:
Altered is a UK-based company that develops professional AI voice software and services, marketed under the Altered Studio brand. The company describes its core offering as a voice content creation platform that combines Speech-To-Speech Voice Morphing with a range of Voice AI technologies in a single application aimed at media production. It also offers a Voice Editor for modifying voices within existing audio and video files, blending traditional DSP effects with AI tools, and a product called RealTime Pro, a voice changer designed for use during voice and video calls.

The site's tracked product listing notes that Altered's platform covers voice morphing, dubbing, and consent management, and that it is UK-hosted. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
